title: MailboxFilterCondition.parent_id uses Option<serde_json::Value> in public API
description: parent_id: Option<serde_json::Value> preserves the three-way absent/null/id distinction without a custom deserializer, but exposes serde internals in a public API type. Backend implementors must pattern-match on raw Value::Null vs Value::String. Doc comment explains the choice. Alternative: a dedicated enum ParentIdFilter { Absent, Null, Id(Id) } with custom Deserialize, or serde deserialize_with. Not urgent but is a leaky abstraction.
